records.title: ForceVLA: Enhancing VLA Models with a Force-aware MoE for Contact-rich Manipulation
records.reason: Full text adds force-aware modality routing with an MoE for contact-rich robotic manipulation, but the paper centers on robot control and does not identify sparse-compute, faster inference, lower memory, or reduced latency as an objective. MoE architecture creates only a weak speculative systems connection.

records.title: Diffusion Adversarial Post-Training for One-Step Video Generation
records.reason: This paper post-trains a diffusion model for one-step video generation; the method concerns diffusion video generation rather than LLM inference.

records.title: An Investigation of Incorporating Mamba For Speech Enhancement
records.reason: The work incorporates Mamba into speech enhancement; it is an audio enhancement model, not LLM inference optimization.

records.title: An automatic fire detection system based on deep convolutional neural networks for low-power, resource-constrained devices
records.reason: The publisher paper is a CNN-based fire-detection system for low-power devices. Device constraints are in the application setting, but the method is not LLM inference or a transferable LLM serving technique.

records.title: Communication-Efficient Distributed Deep Learning: A Comprehensive Survey
records.reason: The primary arXiv survey concerns communication-efficient distributed deep-learning training, including synchronization and training communication compression; it does not present LLM inference/serving methods.
